steps.npc: [Brother/Sister] [player name] - welcome to the Realm of Memories.

options.text: What did you do before you came here?

steps.player: What did you do before you came here?

steps.npc: I worked in a chapel dedicated to our lord, Saradomin. My task was to light the chapel candles, but I couldn't reach them myself and I kept getting dazzled by the light whenever I tried.
I'd call adventurers from across the world, summoning them to my chapel to do the task for me. I needed them to light the tall candles, but not the short ones.
However, adventurers got confused, and thought they should light the short candles as well as the tall candles, so I made them try again. And again.
Eventually my chapel was closed down. They said I'd trapped adventurers there for too long. All I wanted was for them to light the tall candles without lighting the short candles!
Anyway, now I live here, and remember the good old days. It is nice to meet you, [player name].
Yes, it is a common name. I also know of Party Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pirate Pete, Petrified Pete and 'Picarron' Pete. The Makeover Mage has used the name Pete too.
Although we are not related, the shared bond of that name can be a comfort in dark times.
